before.requirement: Link the archive from the root libcares.la target.
before.reason: The root Makefile defines libcares.la, matching the harness's root archive operand. This assesses the path, not a demonstrated successful build.

after.requirement: Link the archive from the src/lib libcares.la target.
after.reason: The library target is now defined in src/lib/, and the root Makefile descends into subdirectories. The harness still supplies the root .libs/libcares.a path.
